questions.question: What does the psalm writer say is his comfort when he is suffering?

answers.text: God's promise has given him life
His enemies have finally gone quiet
His friends have stayed close by

questions.question: The psalm writer said that when the arrogant mocked him, he turned away from God's law. True or false?
Why does the psalm writer say it was good for him to suffer?

answers.text: So he might learn God's statutes
So his enemies would leave him
So he could rest from his work

questions.question: The psalm writer says the law from God's mouth is more precious to him than what?

answers.text: Thousands of pieces of gold and silver
A king's crown and all his jewels
Herds of cattle and fields of grain
